title_en: Spring 2027 Electrical Engineering Design Project (Graduation Project) Schedule
summary: Students preparing to take the Electrical Engineering Design Project (Graduation Project) in Spring 2027 must choose and apply for a project through the department intranet (Department website > Intranet > Classes > Graduation Project Topic Check and Preference), with first-round preferences open from 21 October (Wed) to 28 October (Wed). After an interview with the preferred professor, students must submit a paper interview confirmation form to the department office in Building 301, Room 308 (the office inside the laboratory), during the interview period. All students must then attend the midterm presentations (March–May), give a poster presentation in the last week of May, and submit a graduation thesis in early to mid June.
applies_to: Students preparing to take the Electrical Engineering Design Project (Graduation Project) in Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기). The notice states no further limits. Attendance at the midterm presentations is mandatory for all students.

dates.what: Project proposal period: each laboratory uploads its proposed projects

dates.when: Until the end of the interview period

dates.what: First-round change period (no new preferences allowed)
First-round interviews with the preferred professor and paper submission of the interview confirmation form

Third-round project assignment (assignment after the interview confirmation form, signed by the supervising professor, is confirmed as submitted); a fourth-round assignment is also listed with no separate date given
Midterm presentations (3 sessions, one of which is a thesis lecture); all students must attend; exact dates will be announced on the website at the time
dates.when: Between March and May, at intervals of 2–3 weeks

dates.what: Graduation thesis submission (separate notice to follow)

conditions: New preferences cannot be submitted during the change period; only existing preferences may be changed.
The interview confirmation form must be submitted on paper (a printed hard copy), using the attached form.
Third-round assignment is made only after submission of the interview confirmation form is confirmed.
The supervising professor's signature on the interview confirmation form must be completed.
All students must attend the midterm presentations.
Students not assigned in the first round may apply in the second round, and later in the third and fourth rounds, as listed in the schedule.
steps: Download and read the attached form "2027학년도 1학기_면담확인서 양식.hwp" (interview confirmation form); its content was not read for this translation.
Check the proposed projects on the department website: Department website > Intranet > Classes > Graduation Project Topic Check and Preference [학부 홈페이지 > 인트라넷 접속 > 수업 > 졸업프로젝트 과제 확인 및 지망].
Submit your first-round preference through the same intranet menu between 21 October and 28 October.
If needed, change your preference between 29 October and 2 November (new preferences are not accepted in this period).

Between 3 November and 17 November, meet the professor you wish to work with, complete the interview confirmation form, and submit it on paper to the department office in Building 301, Room 308 (the office inside the laboratory).
Check the first-round assignment result on 18 November.
If not assigned, follow the second-round schedule: preference 19–26 November, change 27 November–1 December, interviews 2–16 December, and check the result on 17 December.
If still not assigned, apply in the third-round assignment (18 December–26 February) by submitting the interview confirmation form with the supervising professor's signature completed.
Attend all three midterm presentations between March and May; watch the department website for exact dates.
Give a poster presentation in the Building 301 first-floor corridor in the last week of May.
Submit your graduation thesis in early to mid June, following the separate notice that will be posted.
translation:
[Spring 2027] Electrical Engineering Design Project (Graduation Project) Information

Spring 2027 Electrical Engineering Design Project (Graduation Project) Schedule

The project preference process and the overall schedule for the Spring 2027 graduation project are announced below. Please refer to the schedule below and prepare for the Spring 2027 graduation project.

※ Method: Department website > Intranet > Classes > Graduation Project Topic Check and Preference [학부 홈페이지 > 인트라넷 접속 > 수업 > 졸업프로젝트 과제 확인 및 지망]

Assignment stage | Schedule | Duration | Remarks

Project proposal | 10.1 (Thu) – 11.2 (Mon) | 4 weeks | Each laboratory uploads its projects

Project announcement | Until the end of the interview period | | Announced on the intranet

1st preference | 10.21 (Wed) – 10.28 (Wed) | 7 days | Students apply

1st change | 10.29 (Thu) – 11.2 (Mon) | 3 days | New preferences not allowed

1st interview | 11.3 (Tue) – 11.17 (Tue) | 2 weeks | After an interview with the professor you wish to apply to, submit the "interview confirmation form" [면담확인서] on paper. *Form: see attachment. Office of the staff member in charge: Building 301, Room 308 (office inside the laboratory)

1st assignment announcement | 11.18 (Wed) | 1 day |

2nd preference | 11.19 (Thu) – 11.26 (Thu) | 1 week |

2nd change | 11.27 (Fri) – 12.1 (Tue) | 2 days |

2nd interview | 12.2 (Wed) – 12.16 (Wed) | 2 weeks |

2nd assignment announcement | 12.17 (Thu) | 1 day |

3rd project assignment | 12.18 (Fri) – 2.26 (Fri) | 3 months | Assigned after submission of the interview confirmation form is confirmed (the supervising professor's signature must be completed)

4th project assignment | (no separate date stated)

Midterm presentations | Between March and May, at intervals of 2–3 weeks (one of the 3 sessions is a thesis lecture) | 3 sessions | All students must attend. Exact dates will be announced on the website at the time.

Final presentation | Last week of May | 1 day | Poster presentation in the 1st-floor corridor of Building 301

Graduation thesis submission | Early to mid June | | A separate notice will be posted

* For inquiries, please contact the staff member in charge at the department office (contact details are in the original notice).

Attachment (1)
2027학년도 1학기_면담확인서 양식.hwp (Spring 2027 interview confirmation form, 27 KB) — the content of this attachment was not read.
